# Toast

A brief confirmation that does not take focus.

- Status: implemented
- Category: feedback
- Pattern: HTML `a role="status" region`
- Text style: `body` (`.nd-text-body`)

## Anatomy

- **surface**: Inverse surface, elevation 2.
- **message**: One sentence.
- **action** (optional): Undo or view.
- **close** (optional): Dismiss button.

## Variants

- `default`:

## States

- `shown`
- `hidden`

## Keyboard

| Keys | Action |
| --- | --- |
| Escape | Dismisses when focus is inside. |

## Accessibility

- Role: status
- Stays until dismissed when it has an action (2.2.1).
- Never the only record of an outcome.

WCAG 2.2 success criteria:

- 2.2.1 Timing Adjustable (A)
- 4.1.3 Status Messages (AA)

Web: `.nd-toast` in kit.css.

## Web example

From the reference page:

```html
<div role="status">
  <div class="nd-toast">
    <span>Copied to the clipboard.</span>
    <button type="button" class="nd-button nd-button--quiet">Undo</button>
  </div>
</div>
```
